name: @stadtmessungsamt-stuttgart/geoline.ol.js
description: Bibliothek zur einfachen Einbindung von Kartendiensten des Stadtmessungsamtes Stuttgart in OpenLayers
author: Stadtmessungsamt, LHS Stuttgart

scripts.build-dist: webpack --config webpack.dist.config.cjs --mode production && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/third-party-licenses.mjs
scripts.pack-dist: npm run build-dist && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && rm -rf .pack && mkdir .pack && npm pack --pack-destination .pack
scripts.serve-examples: npm run build-dist && webpack serve --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --port 8080 --open
scripts.start-dev: concurrently "npm run build-dev" "webpack --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --watch" "npm run serve-examples"
scripts.test-consumer: node scripts/check-consumer.mjs && cypress run --config-file cypress.consumer.config.js --browser chrome
scripts.test-e2e: concurrently -k -s first "webpack serve --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --port 8080" "wait-on http://localhost:8080 && cypress run --browser chrome"
scripts.test-e2e-firefox: concurrently -k -s first "webpack serve --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --port 8080" "wait-on http://localhost:8080 && cypress run --browser firefox"
scripts.cypress-api: npm run build-dist && npm run test-api
scripts.cypress-run: npm run build-dist && npm run test-e2e
scripts.cypress-open: npm run build-dist && concurrently -k -s first "webpack serve --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --port 8080" "wait-on http://localhost:8080 && cypress open"
